reply.text: That sounds painful, and I'm sorry you're dealing with it. A separated shoulder, and a grade 2 one at that, is one for a doctor or physio to assess and manage, not a coach, so please get it looked at properly and follow what they tell you. I won't be able to judge what's safe for it or what to avoid. When they've cleared you for training, tell me what they say and I'll build around it. Until then, we can talk about the rest of your training, or just get you back on your feet.
